description: Held-out retrieval questions on two repos never used while building or tuning retrieval. Written, and the search settings (hybrid default, test-file weight 0.7) fixed, before retrieval ran on these repos. Unlike the first set, about half the questions include a name a developer would know from an error message or config file, since real questions often do.
